data.title: 塑心 · 谱上的批注
data.description: 她把一处旋律圈出来，在旁边补了几个记号，随后轻轻哼出另一种演奏方式。
data.camera: 中近景，乐谱与铅笔清晰
data.promptProse: Virtuosa sits poised before a carved wooden music stand, using a fine pencil to circle complex notations on a fresh score. A classic green-shaded banker's lamp casts an intimate cone of warm golden light over the scattered manuscripts and eraser dust on the desk.
data.animaCaption: With pencil poised over the stave, she marks a sudden harmonic variation, humming the revised phrase under her breath in the lamplight.
